violations.description: Preventing contamination by employees. — --Salads are made out of same make table as pizza topping. Gloves and/or utensils are not always used when plating salad toppings or adding toppings to pizzas.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. -Wet cloth left at prep table between uses. *COS-made bucket immediately.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. -Frost build up at interior upper surface of upright stainless freezer.

Mechanical cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --Sanitize solution for mechanical ware washing machine was not maintained at the proper concentration. -Dishwasher found with 0ppm Chlorine solution. *Primed line 2 times and still found with 0ppm Chlorine. Could not get chemical to feed through line. -Bar dishware will need to be manually sanitized until dishwasher is fixed. Recommend using 3 comp sink in kitchen.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. -2 sleeves of pizza flats stored on floor. -1 case of packets of red pepper flakes stored on floor. *Corrected on site, all items moved off of floor.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. Wet clothes sitting on the hand sink in the kitchen, need to be in a sanitizing solution between uses.

Cooling of potentially hazardous food. — --Cooked potentially hazardous food was not cooled properly from 140F to 70F or below within two hours. Product put in the walk-in cooler at approximately 11am, found at 3:30 temping over 70 degrees.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored, handled, dispensed in a manner to protect from contamination. Boxes of single-use items stored on the floor next to the rack with flour stored on it.

Employee dressing areas and lockers. — --Lockers or other suitable facilities were not provided for the orderly storage of employees' clothing/possessions. Sweater and purse hanging on the end of the clean dish storage rack.
Method, clean, temp, concentration, exposure time, equipment/utensils sanitized (4 pts deducted)
Number, location, accessibility, soap and paper towels provided (3 pts deducted)
Clean clothes, hair restraints, fingernail maint., jewelry, eating/drinking (1 pt deducted)
Properly designed, located, constructed, operated, maintained, cleaned and chemical test kit provided (2 pts deducted)
Clean dry location, protected (1 pt deducted)
Bare hand contact avoided, single- use gloves, and utensils used (3 pts deducted)
Designed, constructed, installed, and maintained (2 pts deducted)
Handwashing, good hygienic practices (5 pts deducted)
